brief:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is attempting to redirect the Gaza plan toward implementing Israeli demands, according to specialist in Israeli affairs Dr. Mamoun Abu Amer, Shehab Wire reported. The redirection would prioritize the disarmament of Hamas movement as a core condition of any agreement.

Abu Amer's assessment reflects the broader contention over Gaza's future governance and security arrangements. Netanyahu's government has sought to embed specific conditions into negotiations, centering on the removal of Hamas's military capabilities as a prerequisite for any settlement. The characterization underscores the gulf between Israeli negotiating positions and other parties involved in discussions over Gaza's status and reconstruction.
